name: Hello Kitty
author: zhou-jianwen
variant_note: An independently generated V2 Hello Kitty interpretation with a simple pink bow, navy polka-dot dress and complete compact body.
description: An unofficial Hello Kitty V2 fan companion in a pink bow and navy polka-dot dress, with gentle task gestures.
source_notes: Unofficial independently AI-generated Hello Kitty fan adaptation for mixed request #311, which explicitly names Hello Kitty and leaves visual direction to the community maker. The request originally linked Cinnamoroll, already covered by merged PRs #313/#348; My Melody is covered by merged PR #321. The adapter selected the official Hello Kitty page https://sanrio.com.cn/family_details1.html and gallery image https://sanrio.com.cn/images/family/1/kv1.jpg for this remaining character. The central mouthless white face, black oval eyes, yellow nose, pink anatomical-LEFT ear bow and navy/pink dress palette guide the adaptation. A plain bow knot simplifies the source rose, bold spots simplify the fabric, and complete white legs/feet are inferred where source flowers obscure them. No source pixels, floral scenery or lettering are submitted. Final pixels use the built-in image_gen tool with native alpha, whole-pose extraction/retiling and deterministic V2 assembly. Both locomotion directions are independently generated; no horizontal mirroring is used. Fresh generation and independent review workers are configured as gpt-6-sol with medium reasoning; the image backend is not disclosed by the tool. zhou-jianwen is the AI-assisted adapter only, not Sanrio, the character creator or reference artist. The reference artist and redistribution permission remain unverified. Underlying character/source-art rights remain with their respective owners; no affiliation, ownership or third-party permission is asserted. Non-commercial fan use only.
